About Me

I'm Puja.
Let's skip the fluff.

I'm a UI/UX and Graphic Designer who spent 5 years turning confusing, ugly, broken things into interfaces people actually enjoy using.

I started as a Reporting & Data Visualisation Analyst — but I kept redesigning everything around me until ExxonMobil made it official and called me a Designer. I've since designed brand systems, app flows, design systems, packaging, and AI product concepts.

I graduated First Class Distinction (GPA 3.7) from Mount Carmel College, Bangalore. Now based in Toronto. Currently very much open to what's next.
